title: Building and the build area
summary: Open Build, pick a building and place it inside your build area. Drones do the rest.
text:
Tap **Build** (or press B), pick a building and tap the ground to place it. If it can't go there, the reason shows right by the cursor: too steep, in the water, overlapping, too far out.

You can build inside the **build area**: round the Command Core, and a short way round every finished building, so the colony grows outward step by step. Walls don't widen it.

- With the build menu open, the number keys pick from it (1 is the first item, 0 the tenth): each shows its key
- V places another of the last building you picked
- R or ⟳ Rotate turns the building while placing
- Shift-click places several in a row
- Select a building to **Switch off** (saves its power), **Repair** or **Recycle** it
- Buildings print up from the ground while a drone works on them

To reach a far deposit or vent without a long chain of buildings, use a **Relay Tower** (or a **Pier** across water): you can build anywhere within its range.
